patreon.title: Moving a file: paths, content, and rename labels
patreon.body:
A guide can outgrow the project’s top folder and belong under documentation. Git’s move command handles the path change and stages its result. A commit is still a separate step.

Git does not store a special permanent rename event. A comparison can infer that a missing old path and a new path represent a rename by comparing their contents. Similarity and comparison settings affect that label.

Takeaway: think in paths and content prepared for the next snapshot. The rename label describes a comparison.

Where would you reorganize a guide in your own project?
